decisionStatement: Release Gate R implementation is READY_FOR_PLATFORM_VALIDATION, not stable-release accepted.
title: Desktop dependency, signing, notarization and publish safety

implementationCommits.subject: fix(release): harden dependency and mac signing gate
fix(release): require manual draft publishing
implementationCommits.reason: Closes the independent security finding that v* tag pushes could create stable GitHub releases automatically.

changeRequestDivergence.assessment: The implemented Hono and 2.x brace-expansion versions are newer security-corrected releases. The 2.1.3 source contains the CVE-2026-14257 maxLength backport, although the registry advisory metadata still reports it as vulnerable.

dependencyResolution: @hono/node-server resolves to 2.0.12 for HyperFrames and the workspace.
brace-expansion resolves to 2.1.3 for the CLI production path and 5.0.8 for the prior 5.x resolution.
PERSONAL_OFFICE_SCHEMA_VERSION and database/schema paths were not changed.
macSigning: The macOS job fails when any required signing/notarization secret name is unconfigured.
Secret values are never printed or copied into repository files.
publishSafety: The workflow is workflow_dispatch-only; pushing a v* tag cannot publish.
Manual dispatch requires release_tag, draft/prerelease selection and explicit confirmation.
The requested tag is validated and checked out exactly.
Root permissions are contents:read; contents:write is limited to the two release jobs.
Both release jobs reference the desktop-release environment.
electron-builder defaults to releaseType=draft and the workflow cannot create or promote a stable release.
Stable promotion remains a separate explicit admin action.

verification.evidence: 0 errors, 347 warnings; below the recorded ceiling of 358.
pnpm build:all, Marketplace API build and CLI build passed.
Frozen lockfile install passed with lifecycle scripts disabled; no package manifest drift followed.

pnpm audit --prod exits 1 with one HIGH finding for brace-expansion@2.1.3. The exact installed 2.1.3 source contains EXPANSION_MAX_LENGTH=4000000 and maxLength guards, and a 128 MB heap test returned 13,333 outputs of maximum length 300 without OOM. This is not recorded as audit-clean.
electron-builder NSIS packaging passed with --publish never. Windows signing is optional under the current policy.
app.asar has 9,114 entries, contains @hono/node-server@2.0.12, and contains no brace-expansion entry; app.asar.unpacked contains neither package.

win-unpacked Izzi AI.exe launched hidden with a temporary user-data directory and mock agent/integration/updater modes. CDP reported title Izzi AI, readyState complete, mounted root content and the fail-closed IzziAPI login page. No mock-auth bypass exists, so authenticated routes were not forged.

YAML parsed with workflow_dispatch as the only trigger, three required inputs, read-only root permissions, job-scoped write permissions and desktop-release environment references. electron-builder JSON parsed with releaseType=draft, notarize=true and hardenedRuntime=true.

verification.check: ownership, prohibited paths and secret scan
verification.evidence: Exactly five implementation paths changed from the lease base. No feature source, DB/schema, auth, updater runtime, secret file or package-workspace manifest changed. Diff-only secret scan found only secret-name references.
2 changed documentation symbols, 0 affected execution processes.
F:\Ai Tools\Tool Starizzi - B2C - Openclaw remained read-only at 959e2d28ece81ceaa1a0f51dde5cc8a0b8d330c5 with 119 status entries.

security.note: The initial accidental-publish blocker was corrected; manual draft/prerelease controls and least-privilege permissions passed re-review.

socrates.note: Stable ACCEPTED remains blocked. The workflow may upload only manually approved draft/prerelease artifacts and cannot promote a stable release.

platformValidationRequired: Verify in GitHub repository settings that desktop-release has required reviewers and self-review disabled.
Windows fresh install, launch, upgrade from the prior supported version and uninstall, including data-retention policy checks.
A real macOS CI run with signing/notarization secrets for x64 and arm64.
Run codesign --verify, stapler validate and spctl --assess against the produced macOS app/DMG.
Use an approved vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag for platform validation; the current beta.3 version is not accepted by the workflow tag validator.
Promote a validated draft/prerelease only through a separate explicit admin action.
